subheadline: Three weeks down. We know nothing. But we're going to judge everybody anyway.

teams.editorialHeadline: THE ONLY UNDEFEATED TEAM, AND NOW THEY'RE GETTING PISSED OFF
teams.editorialText:
There really isn't an argument for anybody else at No. 1 right now.

Team Name hasn't merely stumbled into 3-0. They're the highest-scoring team in the league, and Week 3 was an absolute statement: 281.57, the highest score anybody has put up this season.

The progression is nasty:

245.28 → 206.81 → 281.57

And that Week 3 explosion wasn't against some theoretical opponent—they dropped 281.57 on Old Timer, winning by 84.89 points.

Through three weeks, Team Name has already beaten CunningCarla, Georges and Old Timer.

There's also some historical comedy here. This franchise—Iron Fist / SpoonFed / Robert Paulson / Team Name—has zero championships despite 120 historical wins.

At some point, "good franchise that hasn't won the whole fucking thing" becomes a storyline.
teams.verdict:
They're not chasing anybody right now.

Everybody else is chasing them.

teams.editorialHeadline: THE CHAMP IS STILL THE CHAMP UNTIL SOMEBODY TAKES THE FUCKING THING
teams.editorialText:
Big Ball Jam opened the season with a 216.94–203.33 loss to Georges.

Since then?

242.44.
235.91.
Two wins.

And Week 3 brought a pretty convincing 235.91–200.43 handling of NotoriousFresh.

More importantly, we're talking about the league's historical heavyweight.

The franchise formerly known as Queen of the Mahomes Age / QotMA / BSUAJ / MtFbWY has four championships—the most among the current eight franchises.

And they're coming directly off the 2025 championship run: Big Ball Jam beat Team Name in the semifinal and NotoriousFresh 226.78–199.58 in the title game.
teams.verdict:
Week 1 looks increasingly like somebody poked the bear.

Bad idea.

teams.editorialHeadline: WAIT... ARE THE GEORGES ACTUALLY FUCKING GOOD?
teams.editorialText:
Here's your first genuine 2026 storyline.

Georges opened by beating Big Ball Jam, 216.94–203.33.

Then they lost a very respectable 206.81–202.52 game to undefeated Team Name.

Then they walked into Week 3 and dropped 255.31 on LogJammin'.

That's a hell of a three-game résumé.

And this is where the history makes it funnier.

The updated historical ledger has Georges at just 42-61 (.408) overall, with zero championships.

So we're not watching the old league bully doing what he always does.

We're watching the guy who has historically gotten kicked in the dick suddenly walking around holding a baseball bat.
teams.verdict:
I'm buying it.

And Big Ball Jam already has the receipt.

teams.editorialHeadline: GOOD TEAM. BAD WEEK. CALM THE FUCK DOWN.
teams.editorialText:
Notorious started 2-0 by beating Old Timer 208.76–207.41—by a hilariously tiny 1.35 points—and then hammering 22 Train 240.59–190.61.

Then Big Ball Jam showed up.

235.91–200.43.

That's not catastrophic. It's just a loss to the defending champion.

And don't forget where Notorious was three games ago: playing Big Ball Jam in the 2025 championship game.

This isn't a 2-1 fraud.

It's a legitimate contender that ran into another legitimate contender.
teams.verdict:
Nobody needs to hit the panic button.

But maybe don't schedule Big Ball Jam again anytime soon.

teams.editorialHeadline: THE MOST DANGEROUS 1-2 TEAM IN THE LEAGUE
teams.editorialText:
Here's why these are power rankings and not standings.

CunningCarla is 1-2.

She has scored 671.66 points through three weeks and is averaging 223.89.

Her two losses:

245.28–240.15 to undefeated Team Name.

That's 5.13 points.

Then:

207.95–197.88 to 22 Train.

That's 10.07.

Her one win?

233.63–184.41, a 49.22-point beating of LogJammin'.

So her three-week story is essentially:

close loss, murder, close loss.
teams.verdict:
The standings say 1-2.

The numbers say do not fucking sleep on this team.

This is exactly the kind of team the power rankings are meant to expose.

teams.editorialHeadline: WE HAVE ABSOLUTELY NO IDEA WHAT THIS TEAM IS
teams.editorialText:
Behold:

Week 1: 248.31 — excellent.

Week 2: 190.61 — what the fuck.

Week 3: 207.95 — good enough.

That's resulted in a perfectly respectable 2-1 record, with wins over LogJammin' and CunningCarla and a 49.98-point ass beating at the hands of NotoriousFresh.

But there's an important reason I'm not burying 22 Train.

Last season this offense scored 3,407.57 points, averaging 227.17, the highest 2025 total in our master scoring table.

So the ceiling isn't theoretical.

We've seen it.
teams.verdict:
Could be 4th next week.

Could be 8th.

Could score 290.

Could score 174.

Welcome aboard the fucking train.

teams.editorialHeadline: THE RECORD IS UGLIER THAN THE TEAM. THE LAST GAME WAS UGLIER THAN BOTH.
teams.editorialText:
This is a strange 0-3.

Week 1:

208.76–207.41

Lost by 1.35.

Week 2:

242.44–227.82

Lost by 14.62.

That's an 0-2 team that could reasonably say, "eh, shit happens."

And then Week 3 happened.

Team Name 281.57
Old Timer 196.68

An 84.89-point industrial accident.

Still, history earns Old Timer a little benefit of the doubt.

The master ledger has 84 career wins and three championships.
teams.verdict:
0-3 looks terrible.

But this isn't the worst team in the league.

Yet.

teams.editorialText:
There are unlucky 0-3 teams.

And then there's this.

Week 1: lost by 46.40
Week 2: lost by 49.22
Week 3: lost by 49.45

That is fucking remarkable.

Not because LogJammin' is getting blown out.

Because they're getting blown out by almost exactly the same amount every goddamn week.

Total margin through three games:

-145.07

Average defeat:

48.36 points.

Scores:

201.91 → 184.41 → 205.86

Meanwhile, LogJammin' has historically been one of the league's strongest franchises: 118 wins, a .546 winning percentage, two championships and nine playoff berths.

Which makes this start even weirder.
teams.verdict:
Three games.

Three ass kickings.

Same ass kicking wearing three different hats.

WAKE THE FUCK UP, LOGJAMMIN'.
